program:
(def at [s i] (if (lt i (text-len s)) (nth s i) 0))
(def skip [s i] (if (eq (at s i) 32) (skip s (inc i)) i))
(def digit? [c] (and (ge c 48) (le c 57)))
(def num [s i acc] (if (digit? (at s i)) (num s (inc i) (merge (mul acc 10) (sub (at s i) 48))) (rec val acc pos i)))
(def factor [s i0]
  (let i (skip s i0)
    (let c (at s i)
      (cond (eq c 45) (let r (factor s (inc i)) (put r val (neg (get r val))))
            (eq c 40) (let r (expr s (inc i)) (put r pos (inc (skip s (get r pos)))))
            (num s i 0)))))
(def term-rest [s r]
  (let i (skip s (get r pos))
    (let c (at s i)
      (cond (eq c 42) (let r2 (factor s (inc i)) (term-rest s (rec val (mul (get r val) (get r2 val)) pos (get r2 pos))))
            (eq c 47) (let r2 (factor s (inc i)) (term-rest s (rec val (div (get r val) (get r2 val)) pos (get r2 pos))))
            r))))
(def term [s i] (term-rest s (factor s i)))
(def expr-rest [s r]
  (let i (skip s (get r pos))
    (let c (at s i)
      (cond (eq c 43) (let r2 (term s (inc i)) (expr-rest s (rec val (merge (get r val) (get r2 val)) pos (get r2 pos))))
            (eq c 45) (let r2 (term s (inc i)) (expr-rest s (rec val (sub (get r val) (get r2 val)) pos (get r2 pos))))
            r))))
(def expr [s i] (expr-rest s (term s i)))
(get (expr {s} 0) val)
